summary: Feed s164_triple to NDR is degraded with 3 high-severity faults: 95.2% ERSPAN-encapsulated traffic blinding inspection, 21.72 Gbps microbursts overloading 10 Gbps NDR port (217% capacity), and 17.8% of TCP sessions one-way breaking reassembly.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker / SPAN aggregation is not preserving flow symmetry: 95 of 535 TCP sessions (17.8% >10% threshold) show only one direction. Likely asymmetric routing with per-direction hashing or SPAN missing egress direction, sending client->server and server->client to different tools.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs_both_directions=true for TCP reassembly, state tracking and anomaly detection. One-way flows cannot be reassembled, causing missed detections, incomplete flow records and inaccurate NDR scoring.

recommended_fix.why: Use flow-aware symmetric hashing/aggregation at packet broker so both directions of each 5-tuple are forwarded to this same NDR instance, restoring full session visibility.

findings.root_cause: Aggregate throughput bursts to 21.72 Gbps in 1ms intervals vs NDR port_speed_gbps=10, exceeding capacity by 217% (threshold 80%). No load-balancing or rate-limiting in front of tool; 2 intervals overloaded.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR NIC buffers overflow and drops packets during bursts despite upstream capture showing no drops. Results in random packet loss, missed signatures, truncated flows and degraded detection coverage under load.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic with flow-aware load balancing across 2-3 NDR ports/nodes (or 10G x3) to keep per-port utilization <70-80% while preserving bidirectional flow symmetry.

findings.root_cause: 7165 of 7527 frames (95.2% >10% threshold) arrive inside ERSPAN tunnel. Packet broker is forwarding encapsulated ERSPAN without decapsulation/termination.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR sees only outer ERSPAN/IP/GRE headers, not inner original Ethernet/IP/TCP payload. L2-L7 parsing, application identification and detection signatures fail on 95% of traffic; NDR is effectively blind.

recommended_fix.why: Terminate/strip ERSPAN at packet broker and forward only decapsulated inner frames to NDR so it receives true endpoints and full payload for inspection (needs_full_payload=true).
